body_markdown:
*At Austin's iconic ACL Live theater, Silicon Labs leaders will outline the technologies, AI tools and ecosystem collaboration needed to scale intelligent connected systems*


AUSTIN, Texas


, Sept. 15, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB), the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, today announced the executive keynote lineup for its seventh annual Works With Summit 2026, an invitation-only gathering of customers, technology leaders and ecosystem partners.


**The Technologies Shaping What's Next**


Silicon Labs President and CEO Matt Johnson will open the October 7 keynote at ACL Live at the Moody Theater, joined by Daniel Cooley, senior vice president and chief technology officer, and Manish Kothari, senior vice president of software development.


Together, they will share Silicon Labs' perspective on the technology, AI tools and ecosystem collaboration required to scale the next generation of intelligent systems as connected devices become more capable and deeply integrated into homes, businesses and infrastructure.


During the keynote, Silicon Labs will unveil new products with new-to-industry performance and capabilities, giving attendees an early look at innovations designed to help advance the next generation of connected products.


"Works With brings together the customers, developers, partners, and innovators shaping the future of connected devices," said Johnson. "The conversations taking place at the Summit directly contribute to helping turn new technology into industry-leading products and deployments. For leaders building the connected future, it is a must-attend event."


The keynote will explore how advances in secure, intelligent wireless technology, edge AI and developer tools can help customers build, deploy and manage connected products more effectively. Attendees will also hear Silicon Labs' perspective on the role of connectivity, power, security and ecosystem collaboration in supporting IoT at scale.


**A Forum for the IoT Ecosystem**


Works With Summit 2026 will take place October 6-7 across two distinctive downtown Austin venues: ACL Live at the Moody Theater and Silicon Labs' lakeside headquarters. The invitation-only event will convene some of the industry's most influential IoT innovators for executive keynotes, focused roundtable discussions, and hands-on technology showcases.


Attendees will explore the decisions shaping the next generation of connected products and deployments, including connectivity, batteries and power, security, Matter and Thread, sub-GHz technologies, Wi-SUN, Z-Wave, asset tracking and AI-enabled IoT development. A sponsor technology lab will provide opportunities to experience new solutions and demonstrations in person.


Together, the Summit will offer a setting for Silicon Labs and its ecosystem to exchange perspectives on how low-power wireless, edge intelligence, developer tools and enterprise practices can come together to support IoT at scale.


Attendance is by invitation only, and space is limited. Interested technology leaders can learn more and request an invitation at[silabs.com/about-us/events/works-with-2026](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4775117-1&h=2663666608&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.silabs.com%2Fabout-us%2Fevents%2Fworks-with-2026&a=silabs.com%2Fabout-us%2Fevents%2Fworks-with-2026) . Requests are reviewed by the Silicon Labs team, and submission does not guarantee attendance.


**About Silicon Labs**


Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world's most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers with the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over sixteen countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at[https://www.silabs.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4775117-1&h=694770530&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.silabs.com%2F&a=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.silabs.com) .
